narration.text: And God remembered Noah, and every living thing, and all the cattle that was with him in the ark: and God made a wind to pass over the earth, and the waters asswaged;
Remembered. Not because God had forgotten them, but because the next move was His. A wind swept over the earth, and the great ocean began, slowly, to sink.
